basis: Congenital dilation of the distal ureter within the bladder; both structures belong to the renal axis.
Ependymal tumour arising in the central nervous system; extracranial tumours are rare and do not qualify.

TPM3-related structural skeletal myopathy; respiratory and bulbar weakness reflect muscle dysfunction, without established direct lung or CNS damage.
Sphenoid sinus mucosal inflammation is usually infectious; sinuses belong to the pulmonary axis. Location within sphenoid bone does not establish bone disease.
Neonatal hyperparathyroidism with impaired skeletal mineralization; osteopenia in 2/6 (33%). Motor delay alone does not establish CNS damage.
Scarring photodermatitis defines the supplied concept; keratitis and visual impairment occur in 5-29%, below threshold. An infectious mechanism is not established here.
GNAI1-related neurodevelopmental disorder with universal developmental impairment and frequent epilepsy; feeding difficulty and hypotonia do not establish separate organ damage.
Chromosomal microdeletion syndrome characterized by developmental delay and intellectual disability; other organ damage is insufficiently established at >=30%.
Dysostosis with brachydactyly, skeletal fusions and scoliosis; spina bifida occulta alone does not establish spinal cord damage.
Juvenile motor neuron disease; weakness and loss of ambulation arise from motor neuron dysfunction rather than a primary skeletal muscle disorder.
Neurodegeneration and neuropathy; structural vertebral abnormalities and scoliosis are frequent (30-79%) in supplied HPO. Incontinence and ocular motor signs are neurologic.
AARS1-related white matter disease; neurologic involvement is shared across the umbrella, while hair abnormalities are subtype-specific.
Congenital abnormal lung tissue lacking normal bronchial communication; its systemic arterial supply does not establish a separate cardiovascular disorder.
Premature activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal endocrine axis; an underlying CNS cause would be a separate disease.
Site-unspecified epithelial malignancy; no organ axis applies consistently across its many sites of origin.
Hypertrichosis, skeletal dysplasia and cardiomegaly define Cantu syndrome; mild intellectual disability is frequent (30-79%) in supplied HPO.
TECTA-related nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; no extra-auditory disease is established.
Benign blood vessel neoplasm occupying the small intestine; both intestinal location and vascular origin are defining.
Synovial cyst arising from the knee joint or adjacent bursa.
Congenital muscular dystrophy with defining intellectual disability and brain malformations; retinal findings in 1/4 and cardiac abnormalities in 5-29% are below threshold.
Basal cell carcinoma originates in scrotal skin; this is a cutaneous tumour despite its reproductive-region location.
Obstetric disorder of selective fetal growth restriction; no specific organ damage within the 13 axes is established.
Ischemic necrosis of liver tissue, classified as a hepatic vascular disorder.
GNAT1-related retinal rod phototransduction dysfunction causing congenital stationary night blindness; no separate neurologic involvement.
